future_sea_ice.interpretation: Native prognostic thermodynamic area is the primary future output. The fixed zero-intercept historical operator is used only for 15% extent. source_product_transition.interpretation: The packaged table preserves the Sea Ice Index v4 source-data identifiers. No claim is made that NSIDC-0051 and NSIDC-0803 are measurement-identical; product transition effects are part of the observational uncertainty.

rolling_origin_historical_evaluation.method: Each target year is compared with the fixed emulator trajectory, one-year observed persistence, and an expanding observed linear trend estimated only from prior years.

prospective_untouched_temporal_evaluatio.reason: Records through 2025 and March 2026 were already inspected; 2027 onward is the next defensible untouched window.

scope.interpretation: Broad reduced-sector temperature sanity check only. It is not pointwise SST skill, a regional forecast test, or an independent quantitative validation.
scope.open_water_definition: OISST sea-ice concentration is converted to open_water_fraction=clip(1-ice_concentration,0,1) and included in the weights.
scope.sector_mask: The processor imports climate_model._atlantic_basin_fraction and applies the same smooth fractional Atlantic mask used by the model; non-Atlantic is ocean_fraction minus that Atlantic fraction.

arctic_open_water_observational_validati.mandatory_warning: Arctic open-water temperatures are reduced-sector diagnostics. The OISST comparison is only a broad sanity check; do not interpret it as local, coastal, or quantitative regional forecast validation.

sea_ice.role: native two-sector thermodynamic Northern Hemisphere area with an extent-only observation operator
sea_ice.calibration_period: NOAA/NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4 March/September 1979-2020
sea_ice.validation_informed_development_period: 2021-2025; inspected during v2.29.5/v2.29.6 development and not independent
sea_ice.future_projection_role: native thermodynamic area is primary; frozen zero-intercept seasonal scaling is used only for 15%-concentration extent
sea_ice.longitude_skill: none; optional longitude occupancy is a deterministic area-preserving display reconstruction

arctic_open_water_temperature.validation: broad NOAA OISST temperature sanity check using the model-derived Atlantic fraction mask
arctic_open_water_temperature.warning: Do not interpret as a local, coastal, or point forecast.

amoc.role: sensitivity emulator with full anomalous thermal-density coupling restored
amoc.warning: Scenario weakening and hosing response are sensitivity results, not precise collapse probability or timing forecasts.

greenland.warning: Total contribution is scenario-sensitive; regional geometry and outlet-glacier evolution are not resolved.

evidence_partition.tuning_informed_development_regressions: IPCC/literature ranges and sea-ice records through 2025 used during development; not independent validation
evidence_partition.rolling_origin_historical_evaluation: reported for context but all historical records have been inspected
evidence_partition.external_plausibility_validation: broad NOAA OISST open-water temperature sanity check
evidence_partition.structural_tests: conservation, control stability, timestep, hosing, resolution, native sea-ice integrity and software regressions
